prior_semantic_owner.objective: Audit external latest-wins/conflation, bounded-capacity and concurrency-limiter mechanisms that could improve F2-WP-710 dynamic perception scheduling without adding unnecessary runtime dependencies.

findings: Flow limiting is coupled to explicit downstream FINISHED packets or timestamp bounds, not queue length alone.
max_in_flight and max_in_queue are distinct bounded controls; source comments describe 1/1 as a throughput-latency balance and permit larger in-flight counts for pipeline parallelism.
Queue overflow drops the oldest queued main-stream packet, yielding latest-available behavior when max_in_queue is one.
ALLOW carries timestamp-exact accept/drop transitions and auxiliary streams are gated by allowed timestamp ranges.
in_flight_timeout can abandon stale in-flight timestamps when newer timestamps arrive.
These are external mechanism observations only; no F2 benchmark or architecture acceptance follows.
